title: Inclusive range list
prompt: Write inclusive_range(a, b) returning the list of integers from a to b, both ends INCLUSIVE. a <= b.
reference_solution:
def inclusive_range(a, b):
    return list(range(a, b + 1))
teacher_lesson: When the end is inclusive, use range(a, b + 1).
